verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented CRM integration that automatically logs calls and texts against the matching contact record. Event Streams (twilio-docs-8) and conversation intelligence (twilio-docs-4, twilio-docs-5) are developer building blocks that could be used to build such logging. They are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
